race.comment: TEMPTATION (10) was heavily supported on debut here to start $1.70 and whilst beaten she ran very well, up on speed in the small field and just collared late. Should come on from that and with natural improvement can repay the faith. PIAFFE (9) ran a good race on debut at Kembla Grange when third, beaten a length. Up an extra 100m in trip suits and that form should hold up quite well. Big chance. LOREAL BELLE (1) resumes having run fourth in two runs to date. She's had a couple of solid trials in readiness and can be an improver this time in. ESNAAD (6) was sound on debut at Newcastle and can figure.
